description: EVSE Deployment and Grid Evaluation (EDGE) Tool is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. The EVSE Deployment and Grid Evaluation (EDGE) Tool informs EV charging deployment efforts and associated grid planning and offers users access to related data. EDGE helps users identify regions of the grid that could suitably host EV chargers or may need capacity upgrades. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Transportation, Renewables. Its keywords are electric vehicle charging, charging stations, planning. The portal shows 2025-12-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is No license, or terms of use, asserted by data producer for this dataset was found.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
